invariantRules.rule: Financial Account, Ledger Account, Chart, Policy, Journal Entry, Posting, external event and Balance retain distinct identities.
WM-ECO-015 owns no Chart membership, hierarchy, rollup or posting eligibility.
Every Ledger Account belongs to exactly one ledger and one effective Chart revision at a posting instant.
Account code equality never proves identity across ledgers or Chart revisions.

Every posting carries accountingDate and recordedAt and pins the Ledger Account and policy revisions effective at accountingDate; close permission is evaluated against LedgerPeriod state at recordedAt.
A Ledger Account backing is context- and interval-qualified and at most one WM-ECO-015 Financial Account is effective per context; it is never identity.
Each Journal Entry belongs to one ledger and its postings sum exactly to zero in that ledger's single declared balancing currency role and declared scope vector.
Cross-ledger correlation sets cite candidate-defined divergence-reason codes and never balance, net, plug or correct one another.
Settlement, transaction, functional and presentation currencies use a closed role vocabulary; every WM-ECO-017 assertion includes currencyRole.
Posted entries and lines are immutable; WM-ECO-016 owns the intra-ledger correction relation with closed kinds reverse, adjust and restate.
Hard close permits a correction only in the earliest open permitted later period or as an appended linked entry under an explicit authorityRef exception; it never permits amendment.
Correcting one sibling neither corrects nor freezes another ledger's correlation set.
Every emitted WM-ECO-017 balance assertion is immutable regardless of period state; recomputation emits a successor with its own as-of and basis.
WM-ECO-017 never nets across ledgers and never fuses treasury position with GL balance; balancing and balance assertions use the same policy-declared scope dimension vector.
External event identity is not Journal Entry identity; event-to-entry correlation is many-to-many and grouping is eventRef plus ledgerRef to a set of entries.
Retired Chart, policy and Ledger Account identifiers and revisions remain resolvable and are never recycled.
Ledger Account versions for one ledgerRef and nodeId never overlap; accountCode is unique within one ledger at an effective instant.
Every Posting targets exactly one Ledger Account; a WM-ECO-015 Financial Account is never a posting target.
Lifecycle transitions never alter pinned revisions; suspension blocks new adoption and new postings from its effective instant while prior pins remain valid.
Retirement requires no effective ledger adoption or an effective-dated successor adoption.
At most one Chart adoption is effective per ledger at any instant across all Charts; supersession closes prospectively and never invalidates a posted pin.
Ledger adoption carries at most one effective policy revision per policyKind; Ledger Account narrowing must remain in the adopted lineage and adoption governs conflict.
Each ledger declares exactly one balancing currency role; translation residuals post inside that ledger to its designated residual Ledger Account.
Tolerance is detection-only; every nonzero residual is posted in-ledger so postings sum exactly to zero in the balancing currency role.
Every translated posting pins WM-XCT-014 rate identity and revision; rate correction requires a linked same-ledger correction and never recomputes posted amount in place.
Close state is authoritative only from the LedgerPeriod object.
Divergence is attached to each ledger's event-correlation set, uses the candidate's closed vocabulary and pins the compared policy revisions.
A Chart revision continuation preserves stable ledgerAccountId and requires predecessorRef; balances remain continuous across the revision boundary.
